Ava (PM): Kicking off an async Q2 OKR milestone pulse. Please drop what shipped, what slipped, and next action items. ETA EOD for owners. :wave:
Rajat (Eng): Runtime v3 dedicated rollout canary at 30% now. Infra tests green, saw a small latency bump on two models (~2ms). PR #4123 merged. Investigating kernel selection path.
Maya (PM): Experimentation macros are behind a feature flag and marked shipped for product scope. Docs PR is in review. @Priya can you take a look later today? :eyes: 
Priya (Eng): On it — will review docs PR #4180 this afternoon. Heads-up: quantization regression showing up in CI on RTX nodes, failing float->int q tests.
Jon (SRE): Observability note: we see request spike correlating with canary traffic. Tracing points to autoscale policy throttle. I can temporarily widen the target if we need smoother rollout.
Ava (PM): TL;DR: Shipped: macros (feature-flag); Partial: runtime canary; Slipped: quant tests. Owners: macros -> Maya, canary/runtime -> Rajat, quant triage -> Priya + Eng-ML.
Rajat (Eng): Quick status table for clarity:
```
Milestone | Owner      | Status    | Next action / blocker
Runtime v3 canary | Rajat       | Canary=30% | Investigate kernel latency (+2ms)
Experiment macros  | Maya        | Shipped (FF) | Docs PR -> review
Quantization tests | Priya/Raj   | Failed CI | Repro on RTX, need kernel logs
Observability tweak | Jon         | Investigating | Potential autoscale tweak
```
Priya (Eng): Repro steps: `bazel test //eng-ml/quant:all --config=rtx` fails with `nan in scale` on 2/8 seeds. I can run kernels locally but need access to the dedicated GPU pool image. 
Ava (PM): Next steps: 1) Priya to triage quant failure and post root cause or a short mitigation by EOD. 2) Rajat to continue canary and share latency diff by model. 3) Jon to monitor and widen autoscale if user impact increases. 4) Maya to merge docs once PR approved. Owners please update this thread when you have an update.
Rajat (Eng): Action: I'll post perf diff per model in ~2 hours. If latency persists after kernel switch, fallback to previous kernel version for the canary.
Maya (PM): Docs PR #4180 updated with requested copy changes, awaiting review from Priya. Will block on merge until PR approved.
Priya (Eng): I can run a debug job on the dedicated pool, but need permission to attach to the job image. @Jon can you grant access or kick off the debug job with me?
Jon (SRE): I'll spawn a debug job and grant access to Priya. ETA ~30m. I'll also add a temporary autoscale tolerance +10% for the canary window.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started by rajat@redwood at 2026-03-18T14:00:22Z (canary:30%).
Ava (PM): Thanks all — please ping if anything touches SLAs. I'll compile a short note for execs if any slip turns into a wider delay. :memo:
Rajat (Eng): Posting perf diffs now: https://internal.redwood/patches/4123/perf-diff (will paste numbers shortly).
Priya (Eng): Debug job attached, reproducer captured. Preliminary signal points to int8 kernel path under specific padding. Continuing.
Ava (PM): Perfect. If quant fix will take >1d, propose a short rollback plan for models most affected. Add to this thread.
Rajat (Eng): Agreed — I'll prepare a rollback playbook if needed.
Maya (PM): Noted. I'll wait for PR review and will coordinate release notes post-merge. :white_check_mark:
Ava (PM): End status for now: macros shipped (FF), runtime canary ongoing, quant tests blocking final rollout. Owners: Priya+Rajat+Jon. Update this thread with any owner changes.
